name: benarunski-utils
description: Public Claude Code skills and standalone utilities from BenArunskiUtils.

plugins.name: tts
plugins.description: Convert a text/markdown document into spoken-word MP3 audio, after rewriting the source into speech-friendly prose so non-text elements read aloud correctly. Use when asked to convert a document to audio, to read something aloud, or when TTS or text to speech is mentioned.

plugins.name: explain-yourself
plugins.description: Explain a code file, directory, pull request, commit, or diff, spoken aloud when the tts skill is installed and in writing otherwise. A PR, commit, or diff gets a file-by-file walkthrough of what changed and why; a file or directory gets a top-down explanation of structure, interactions, then the details that matter. Use when the user wants a change or a piece of code explained, walked through, or summarized.
